queries.HepG4-seq Development: We will exploit t: antibody-free native G-quadruplex mapping in living cells using hemin-biotin aniline peroxidase oxidation, phenoxyl radical biotinylation of G4s and proximal DNA, streptavidin nanobody recruitment, and Tn5 CUT&Tag sequencing
queries.HBD-seq Optimization: We will optimize e: Stable EGFP-V5-tagged RNase H1 hybrid-binding domain construct for optimized HBD-seq, antibody-free genome-wide mapping of native DNA/RNA hybrids and R-loops in living cells, complementary to G4 detection
queries.Genome-wide Mapping: Perform HepG4-seq a: Genome-wide co-localization of native G-quadruplexes and R-loops in HEK293 and mouse embryonic stem cells using HepG4-seq and HBD-seq, biological replicates, negative controls, and bioinformatics intersection analysis of regulatory regions
queries.Validation Strategy: We will validate me: Validation of antibody-free G4 mapping with hemin biotin aniline labeling, BG4 CUT&Tag controls, RNase HBD-seq controls, predicted G4-forming sequences, BLM, WRN helicase inhibitors ML216, NSC617145 in living cells
queries.Functional Characterization: Analyze gen: Functional characterization of native co-localized G-quadruplexes and R-loops relative to promoters, enhancers, gene bodies, histone modifications, RNA polymerase II occupancy, and RNA-seq transcriptional activity to link them to transcriptional regulatory architecture in human cells and mouse embryonic stem cells
queries.Helicase Regulation Studies: Focus on Dh: Dhx9 helicase knockout mouse embryonic stem cells CRISPR CUT&Tag mapping of G-quadruplex and R-loop co-localization and transcriptional effects on self-renewal differentiation
queries.Functional Validation: Examine expressio: Functional validation of Dhx9 knockout mouse embryonic stem cells using pluripotency markers Oct4 Nanog Lin28a, cell cycle proliferation, embryoid body differentiation, and germ layer markers to assess G-quadruplex R-loop co-localization in stem cell maintenance
queries.Statistical Analysis: We will use standa: Statistical analysis of genome-wide G-quadruplex and R-loop mapping using DESeq2 differential expression, Mann-Whitney signal distribution comparisons, and Gene Ontology enrichment in living cells and Dhx9 knockout embryonic stem cells
